item.title: Books
item.description: Books by Jacques Serizay, including Orchestrating Hi-C analysis with Bioconductor (OHCA), a free online book on Hi-C data analysis.

item.title: Courses
item.description: Courses and workshops taught by Jacques Serizay on genomics data analysis with R/Bioconductor: single-cell and bulk RNA-seq, epigenomics, ATAC-seq, multi-omics and package development.

item.title: Papers
item.description: Research papers by Jacques Serizay on genome organization, chromatin and gene regulation, with PDFs and supplementary materials.

item.title: Software
item.description: Open-source R/Bioconductor and Python packages for Hi-C and genome-wide omics data, developed and maintained by Jacques Serizay.
